result.instructions: Tools for Open Dental, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show today's appointments with patient names and operatories."; "Which patients are due for a recall this month and haven't been reminded?"; "Find open 60-minute slots for Dr. Albert next week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Open Dental data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run opendental_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run opendental_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run opendental_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. opendental_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: opendental_get_api_permissions
tools.title: Get API permissions
tools.description: The API permissions this customer key has (ReadAll, Appointments, Patients, ...), each true or false. The tools here only read, so ReadAll is the one they need. Use it to explain why a call is refused. GET /securityperms.

tools.name: opendental_list_patients
tools.title: List patients
tools.description: List patients with the fast search (name, birthdate, status, guarantor, primary provider, clinic, changed since). Names match partially, case-insensitive. Returns demographics, balances and contact data (protected health information); SSNs are removed. Page with limit/offset. GET /patients/Simple.

last_name.description: Last name or the start of it.

first_name.description: First name or the start of it.

guarantor.description: PatNum of the guarantor (the person responsible for the account): lists a family.

changed_since.description: Only items changed after this time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (DateTStamp).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_search_patients
tools.title: Search patients
tools.description: Search patients the way Open Dental's Patient Select window does: by name, phone, email, address, city, state, chart number, birthdate or insurance subscriber id. Slower than opendental_list_patients on large databases; use it for phone, email and address lookups. Returns the Patient Select columns only (use opendental_get_patient for the full record). GET /patients.

phone.description: Any of the patient's phone numbers.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_get_patient
tools.title: Get patient
tools.description: One patient's full record by PatNum: name, status, birthdate, contact details, balances, providers, preferred contact methods, urgent notes. SSN is removed. GET /patients/{PatNum}.

tools.name: opendental_get_patient_notes
tools.title: Get patient notes
tools.description: A patient's note fields: family financial, medical, service, medical complete, treatment (odontogram) notes and the emergency contact (ICE name and phone). GET /patientnotes/{PatNum}.

tools.name: opendental_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments, filtered by patient, status, operatory, a day or a date range, clinic, appointment type, or changed since. Each has AptNum, PatNum, status, AptDateTime, pattern, provider, operatory, note and procedures. Use `date` for one day (e.g. today's schedule) or date_start/date_end for a range. GET /appointments.

clinic.description: ClinicNum; 0 = appointments not attached to a clinic.

changed_since.description: Only items changed after this time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (DateTStamp).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: One appointment by AptNum, with its patient, time, provider, operatory, status, confirmation, note and procedures. GET /appointments/{AptNum}.

tools.name: opendental_list_asap_appointments
tools.title: List ASAP appointments
tools.description: The ASAP list: appointments whose priority is ASAP (patients who want an earlier time). ClinicNum is required when the office uses clinics (use 0 for no clinic). GET /appointments/ASAP.

clinic.description: ClinicNum; 0 = not attached to a clinic. Required if clinics are enabled.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_find_open_slots
tools.title: Find open appointment slots
tools.description: Open schedule slots for a provider and operatory (like the Appointments module search): each has DateTimeStart, DateTimeEnd, ProvNum and OpNum. Dates must be today or later; the default is the next 14 days. GET /appointments/Slots.

length_minutes.description: Skip slots shorter than this many minutes.

operatory.description: OperatoryNum the provider is assigned to.

tools.name: opendental_list_providers
tools.title: List providers
tools.description: Providers (dentists, hygienists, billing entities) with ProvNum, abbreviation, name, specialty, status and hidden flags. SSN/TIN is removed. Optionally only providers usable at one clinic, or only those changed since a time (not both). GET /providers.

clinic.description: ClinicNum: non-hidden providers not restricted to another clinic.

changed_since.description: Only items changed after this time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (DateTStamp).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_list_operatories
tools.title: List operatories
tools.description: Operatories (treatment rooms) with OperatoryNum, name, abbreviation, assigned dentist and hygienist, clinic and hidden flag. GET /operatories.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_list_clinics
tools.title: List clinics
tools.description: All non-hidden clinics (locations) with address, billing address and phone. An empty list means the office does not use the Clinics feature. GET /clinics.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_list_appointment_types
tools.title: List appointment types
tools.description: Appointment types (AppointmentTypeNum, name, default pattern, required procedure codes, hidden flag). GET /appointmenttypes.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_list_procedure_codes
tools.title: List procedure codes
tools.description: The office's procedure codes (CodeNum, ADA code, description, category, treatment area, hygiene flag). Use CodeNum to filter procedure logs. Page with limit/offset. GET /procedurecodes.

changed_since.description: Only items changed after this time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (DateTStamp).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_list_procedure_logs
tools.title: List procedures
tools.description: Procedure log entries (treatment-planned, complete, existing, referred, deleted) filtered by patient, appointment, date, status, clinic, procedure code or creation time. Each has ProcNum, PatNum, ProcDate, fee, tooth, surface, status, provider and code. Page with limit/offset. GET /procedurelogs.

status.description: TP treatment plan, C complete, EC/EO existing, R referred out, D deleted, Cn condition, TPi inactive TP.

created_since.description: Procedures created on or after this time.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_list_commlogs
tools.title: List communication log entries
tools.description: Communication log entries (calls, texts, emails, letters) for a patient or changed since a time: CommlogNum, PatNum, date, mode, sent or received, note. Page with limit/offset. GET /commlogs.

changed_since.description: Only items changed after this time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (DateTStamp).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: opendental_list_recalls_due
tools.title: List recalls due
tools.description: The Recall List as in Open Dental's Appointment module: patients due for recall (prophy, perio) with due date, interval, reminders sent, last reminder, preferred contact and status. Defaults follow the office's recall preferences. Page with limit/offset. GET /recalls/List.

include_reminded.description: Include patients who already received a reminder (default false).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.
